definitions.explanation: A room with a wooden or carpeted floor, as opposed to a Japanese-style room with tatami mats. Common in modern Japanese houses and apartments.

examples.japanese: {洋間|ようま}にソファを{置|お}いた。
examples.english: I put a sofa in the Western-style room.

examples.japanese: この{家|いえ}は{和室|わしつ}が{一|ひと}つと{洋間|ようま}が{二|ふた}つある。
examples.english: This house has one Japanese-style room and two Western-style rooms.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}の{新築|しんちく}マンションは{洋間|ようま}ばかりで、{和室|わしつ}がないことが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Recently built apartments often have only Western-style rooms and no Japanese-style rooms.

notes:
OPPOSITE:
- {和室|わしつ}: Japanese-style room (with tatami mats)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {洋室|ようしつ}: Western-style room (synonym; more commonly used in real estate listings)

USAGE NOTES:
{洋間|ようま} and {洋室|ようしつ} are largely interchangeable. {洋室|ようしつ} is more common in formal contexts like apartment listings. A {洋間|ようま} typically has flooring (フローリング) or carpet, with chairs and tables rather than sitting on the floor.
